notes: Understood and produced during placement, then retrieved correctly again in Lesson 001. は as topic marker was explicitly explained in Lesson 001.

japanese: 近くにコンビニがありますか
reading: ちかくにコンビニがありますか
english: Is there a convenience store nearby?
notes: Introduced and explained in Lesson 002. After one early word-order/particle error in a declarative sentence, the learner successfully produced this question from English without being shown the answer. In Lesson 003 due review, the learner attempted 近くにコンビニがります, preserving the location structure but omitting あ in あります and final か; corrected after feedback, so keep on short review.
Introduced in Lesson 003. First production omitted に (何時行きますか); later retrieved correctly in 明日、何時に駅に行きますか and final mastery 明日、何時に行きますか.

japanese: 11月13日の午後五時半に大阪に着きます

english: I will arrive in Osaka at 5:30 PM on November 13.
notes: Built and corrected during ad hoc trip-planning after Lesson 003. Useful real-world message, but intentionally excluded from the main review schedule until explicitly integrated.
